<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Aromatic carbons typically appear in the 110–160 ppm region, so counting the distinct peaks in that range will give the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
